verdict.rationale: Notte's docs mention generating deterministic workflow code/scripts from agent runs that can be reused without re-invoking the LLM ('script deterministic parts and use AI only when needed, cutting costs by 50%+'), and element IDs/selectors can come from previously generated workflow code, implying a form of action caching. However, there is no explicit caching API, no documentation of automatic replay of resolved actions, and no benchmark data on latency/cost savings from reuse. missing for 10: explicit caching mechanism/API, first-party benchmarks on cost/latency savings from replay, independent verification that generated scripts reliably replace live LLM calls on repeat runs.
